# ArraySearchUsedAsInArray

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `ArraySearchUsedAsInArrayInspection`

`array_search()` returns a key (which may be `0` or `''`) or `false`. When its
result is only used as a yes/no answer, `in_array()` expresses the intent
directly and avoids the classic "key 0 is falsy" trap. Comparing its result
with `true` is always pointless, since the function never returns `true`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,8,9,10} [Before]
<?php
function audit(array $roles, $who, $flag) {
    if (array_search($who, $roles)) { log_hit(); }
    while (!\array_search($who, $roles, true)) { $who = next_user(); }
    $ok = ((array_search('root', $roles))) && $flag;
    $tag = array_search($who, $roles) ? 'known' : 'stranger';

    $miss = array_search($who, $roles) === FALSE;
    $hit  = false !== array_search($who, $roles);
    $odd  = array_search($who, $roles) === true;

    $key   = array_search($who, $roles) ?: 'none';
    $other = $flag ?? array_search($who, $roles);
    $loose = array_search($who, $roles) == false;
    $wrap  = (array_search($who, $roles)) !== false;
    $one   = array_search($who);
    return $flag xor array_search($who, $roles);
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function audit(array $roles, $who, $flag) {
    if (in_array($who, $roles)) { log_hit(); }
    while (!\in_array($who, $roles, true)) { $who = next_user(); }
    $ok = ((in_array('root', $roles))) && $flag;
    $tag = in_array($who, $roles) ? 'known' : 'stranger';

    $miss = !in_array($who, $roles);
    $hit  = in_array($who, $roles);
    $odd  = array_search($who, $roles) === true;

    $key   = array_search($who, $roles) ?: 'none';
    $other = $flag ?? array_search($who, $roles);
    $loose = array_search($who, $roles) == false;
    $wrap  = (array_search($who, $roles)) !== false;
    $one   = array_search($who);
    return $flag xor array_search($who, $roles);
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 5: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 6: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 8: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 9: Use &#39;in_array(...)&#39; to test membership.</li>
<li>line 10: array_search() cannot return true; this comparison never changes.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ArraySearchUsedAsInArray": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ArraySearchUsedAsInArray

/**
 * @noinspection ArraySearchUsedAsInArrayInspection
 */
```
